summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the advanced package substrate / ABF node. The cleanest direct exposures are mostly non-US companies available through OTC ADRs or foreign ordinaries, while the US-exchange discovery lane is more second-order: OSAT capacity, advanced packaging tools, and substrate-fabrication equipment. The list deliberately includes only four names: two direct reference anchors, one US-listed advanced-packaging platform, and one small-cap equipment/speculative-shadow candidate. This pass expands the US-listed universe around the ABF/package-substrate chokepoint. The most direct substrate and ABF-film leaders named in the supplied context are mostly non-US primary listings or OTC ADRs, so the cleaner US-listed discovery lane is second-order: inspection/metrology, panel-level packaging tools, IC-substrate process control, plating chemistry/equipment, and yield-enabling process vendors. The strongest US-listed candidates for this node are KLA, Onto Innovation, Camtek, and MKS Instruments/Atotech. KLA is a reference leader; Onto, Camtek, and MKS are more relevant to the underfollowed lane because they map to substrate yield, panel-level packaging, micro-bump/chiplet/HBM inspection, ABF-compatible plating, and fine-line substrate manufacturing rather than headline GPU design. Expanded the US-listed universe around the ABF substrate bottleneck with a two-lane funnel.
